search_scope: TASK170-TASK172 reviewed task documents and authority registry
R95-R103 mesh/reference evidence and registry entries
TASK171 topology, mapping, identity, and status implementation

review_findings.artifact: R104 evidence, transfer matrix, r104_extension, authority registry
review_findings.r104_claim: R104 artifact and registry canonical hashes are valid under existing canonical JSON and are linked.
review_findings.independent_finding: Direct file SHA values match, but four canonical hashes differ from the shared hexagent.canonical_json.canonical_sha256 recomputation.
review_findings.required_correction: Append-only correction must bind hashes recomputed with the shared project canonicalization; do not rewrite R104.

review_findings.artifact: R104 contract evidence and document production admission predicate
review_findings.r104_claim: Unbound production policy operands necessarily make real-case mesh admission false.
review_findings.independent_finding: The predicate does not explicitly gate headroom_rule_bound, reference_policy_bound, wall_acceptance_rule_bound, normalized descriptor disposition, or real-case rounding applicability; no definition makes mesh_profile_authority_valid/convergence_rule_bound a composite gate over those separate unbound slots.
review_findings.source_authority: R104 contract evidence's separately unbound fields; TASK172 mesh contract §§11-12; R98 scoped review
review_findings.required_correction: Define composite-validity semantics or explicitly gate each applicable policy decision; absence must not default true. No numeric value may be introduced.

review_findings.r104_claim: TASK172 mesh model schema requires headroom evidence.
review_findings.independent_finding: TASK172 §11 requires a future criterion to bind consecutive evidence and related criterion fields; it does not specify a headroom requirement. R104's fail-closed additional-authority disposition is appropriate, but this source attribution is unsupported.
review_findings.required_correction: Describe headroom as a proposed R104 project-contract slot or future criterion, not inherited TASK172 authority; keep its value unbound.

real_case_quantitative_mesh_gaps.why_unbound: R103 thresholds are synthetic-only; no real-case error budget or thresholds are reviewed.

real_case_quantitative_mesh_gaps.required_evidence: Separate authority for a real-case headroom criterion, if selected.

real_case_quantitative_mesh_gaps.why_unbound: R103 cap grid is synthetic feasibility evidence; TASK171's raw-record limit is not a mesh cap.
R102 is a synthetic reference qualification producer and does not require online production references.
